items.reasoning: The roof leak was triaged on its own as urgent. The tenant message asked where the roof is leaking, how much water is coming in, for photos, and whether water is near lights or sockets. It also gave safety advice: keep away and switch that circuit off if safe, and call 999 if there is immediate danger. It did not ask whether the leak is getting worse or give bucket-style containment advice. Still, the extent questions and the electrical isolation advice meet the intent.
